purpose: SECONDARY exploratory consistency of independently heard musical attributes; NOT direct perceptual similarity or a qualified MOSS pair judge. Introduced after all three direct-judge pilots failed; preserve every failure. No algorithm is chosen from this metric alone.
gate: All15 control outputs schema valid, correct audible_music for6 real clips and3 silent clips;6 byte-identical repeats have identical categorical features; no truncations. Main requires>=95% schema-valid and>=90% audible_music for expected music; report all omissions. Judge is not acoustically gold-labelled.
sampling: Same36 original common anchors (358 eligible); two peers chosen uniformly from each original three different-artist region peers, five configurations. Two12s positions per track. Also all24 original true-rank neighbor anchors at weights25/50/60/75. Random reference from preselected eligible audio-access subset, not full-library random.
metric: Equal-weight mean of six predeclared feature similarities: instrument-set Jaccard; vocal, texture, groove exact agreement; pulse ordinal 1-|difference|/3 (none,slow,medium,fast); energy ordinal 1-|difference|/2. Unknown values excluded. At least4 valid dimensions. Compare all4 cross-position combinations per track-pair then average peers per anchor. 98.75% artist-cluster bootstrap CIs for four comparisons vs installed average,10000 draws. Reused peers create residual dependence; intervals exploratory. No learned embeddings or metadata in scoring.
reliability: Compare same-track cross-position agreement with randomly permuted different tracks (fixed seed) and report per-dimension stability, missingness and marginal entropy. If within-track agreement does not exceed random with95% bootstrapCI, no comparative inference.
